//: Pins the .NET SDK feature band for every developer and for CI.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: Directory.Build.props pins LangVersion to 12.0 and warns that a
developer on a newer SDK could commit C# 13+ syntax that compiles locally and fails in
CI. That warning had no enforcement — a teammate with the .NET 9 or 10 SDK installed
would still build fine on their machine. This file turns that silent divergence into an
immediate, readable error at the first `dotnet` command:
A compatible .NET SDK was not found. Requested: 8.0.100 (rollForward latestFeature)
rollForward=latestFeature accepts ANY 8.0.x SDK at or above 8.0.100 (so 8.0.423 on one
machine and 8.0.100 on another are both fine) and rejects 9.x / 10.x outright, which is
exactly the boundary .github/workflows/ci.yml enforces with dotnet-version: 8.0.x.
If the team ever moves to .NET 9, three files change in the SAME PR: this one, the
LangVersion in Directory.Build.props, and dotnet-version in ci.yml.
